text: Write a C function to check if the given string starts with a substring using regex.

args: dreams for dreams makes life fun
test_cases.expected: string doesnt start with the given substring
test_cases.assert_src: assert check_substring("dreams for dreams makes life fun", "makes") == 'string doesnt start with the given substring'

args: Hi there how are you Hi alex
test_cases.expected: string starts with the given substring
test_cases.assert_src: assert check_substring("Hi there how are you Hi alex", "Hi") == 'string starts with the given substring'

test_cases.expected: string doesnt start with the given substring
test_cases.assert_src: assert check_substring("Its been a long day", "been") == 'string doesnt start with the given substring'
